source_candidates.title: Spiral magnetic ordering in bismuth ferrite
source_candidates.independence_note: Original high-resolution time-of-flight neutron diffraction report of the long-period bulk cycloid.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Bulk BiFeO3 specimen; exact physical form remains pending full-text Source Map review
source_candidates.method_scope: High-resolution time-of-flight neutron diffraction and magnetic-peak splitting
source_candidates.reported_lead: Cycloidal spiral period of 620 plus or minus 20 angstrom.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The diffraction-derived bulk period is not an unconditional thin-film value and its original angstrom uncertainty must be preserved.

source_candidates.title: Real-space imaging of non-collinear antiferromagnetic order with a single-spin magnetometer
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent real-space experiment using a scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometer rather than neutron peak splitting.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Thirty-two nanometre BiFeO3 film on SrRuO3 buffered DyScO3
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry with quantitative stray-field fitting
source_candidates.reported_lead: Real-space spin-cycloid period of about 70 nanometres.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Approximate real-space fitting on one strained heterostructure is only a cross-method comparison, not exact reproduction of the bulk number.

source_candidates.title: Antiferromagnetic textures in BiFeO3 controlled by strain and electric field
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent substrate-strain series with local NV imaging and resonant X-ray scattering exposes state-dependent periods.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Thirty to sixty nanometre BiFeO3 films on multiple scandate and SrTiO3 substrates spanning compressive to tensile strain
source_candidates.method_scope: Scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry, PFM writing and resonant elastic X-ray scattering
source_candidates.reported_lead: Period changes from 78 plus or minus 5 to 65 plus or minus 2 nanometres after writing on DyScO3, and reaches 84 plus or minus 3 nanometres at plus 0.50 percent tensile strain.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Substrate strain, surface projection, ferroelectric domain state and electric writing are necessary grouping variables; one universal 62 nanometre value is invalid.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的直接和间接光学带隙如何受拟合定义、薄膜形貌、颗粒尺寸与化学计量影响？

source_candidates.title: Role of Excess Bi on the Properties and Performance of BiFeO3 Thin-Film Photocathodes
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary paired-composition thin-film study with direct Tauc analysis and independent stoichiometry measurements.
source_candidates.sample_scope: About one-hundred nanometre sol-gel BiFeO3 films on FTO with nominal Bi to Fe ratios of 1 to 1 and 1.1 to 1
source_candidates.method_scope: Transmission UV-visible spectroscopy and direct-transition Tauc fitting
source_candidates.reported_lead: Both stoichiometric and excess-bismuth films yield a direct band gap of 2.7 electronvolts.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The equal value is specific to these porous films and a direct Tauc assumption; it does not prove morphology-independent or indirect-gap equality.

source_candidates.title: Measurement of transient photoabsorption and photocurrent of BiFeO3 thin films: Evidence for long-lived trapped photocarriers
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent optical and photocurrent experiment that explicitly classifies the observed gap as indirect.
source_candidates.sample_scope: BiFeO3 thin films; substrate and thickness remain pending full-text Source Map review
source_candidates.method_scope: Absorption spectroscopy, photocurrent and transient photoabsorption
source_candidates.reported_lead: Indirect band-gap energy of about 2.4 electronvolts, with fast and slow carrier-decay components reported separately.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: An indirect absorption and photocurrent onset cannot be substituted for the 2.7 electronvolt direct Tauc result.

source_candidates.title: Experimental and First-Principles Investigations of Lattice Strain Effect on Electronic and Optical Properties of Biotemplated BiFeO3 Nanoparticles
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent nanoparticle experiment deliberately retained as a morphology and analysis boundary.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Biotemplated rhombohedral BiFeO3 nanoparticles with an average crystallite size of 14.59 nanometres
source_candidates.method_scope: Diffuse reflectance with Kubelka-Munk transformation and separate direct and indirect linear fits
source_candidates.reported_lead: Direct and indirect optical gaps of 2.17 and 1.84 electronvolts, respectively.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Nanoparticle diffuse-reflectance fits cannot be pooled with transmission measurements on approximately one-hundred nanometre films.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的相纯工艺窗口能否跨 PLD 腔体、压力区间、衬底和溶液退火路线直接迁移？

source_candidates.title: Influence of parasitic phases on the properties of BiFeO3 epitaxial thin films
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary PLD pressure-temperature growth map linked to phase, magnetic and local-conduction checks.
source_candidates.method_scope: Pressure-temperature growth map with XRD, magnetometry and conductive AFM
source_candidates.reported_lead: Single-phase films occur near 580 degrees Celsius and 0.01 millibar; off-window films contain iron oxides or bismuth oxide.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The point is a chamber-, target- and substrate-bound process window, not a universal BFO recipe.

source_candidates.title: Growth and thermal stability of epitaxial BiFeO3 thin films
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent PLD chamber and growth map on SrTiO3 with RHEED, AFM and XRD characterization.
source_candidates.sample_scope: About two-hundred nanometre epitaxial BiFeO3 films on 001 SrTiO3
source_candidates.method_scope: PLD scan over 600 to 700 degrees Celsius and 0.05 to 0.5 millibar oxygen
source_candidates.reported_lead: High-quality epitaxial films are reported at 650 degrees Celsius and 0.4 millibar.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The different optimum from the 2005 map demonstrates that nominal temperature and oxygen pressure alone do not define transferable equivalence.

source_candidates.title: Effects of annealing temperature on the microstructure, optical, ferroelectric and photovoltaic properties of BiFeO3 thin films prepared by sol-gel method
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent solution route retained to prevent PLD substrate temperature from being conflated with post-deposition annealing.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Sol-gel spin-coated BiFeO3 thin films annealed from 550 to 650 degrees Celsius
source_candidates.method_scope: Annealing series with structure, optical, ferroelectric and photovoltaic characterization
source_candidates.reported_lead: The 550 degree Celsius film is single phase, while higher annealing temperatures produce Bi2Fe4O9 and band gaps span 2.306 to 2.453 electronvolts.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Annealing temperature is not PLD growth temperature; precursor chemistry and thermal duration must be retained before process comparison.
